edits.new:
def _sanitize_model_constraints(values: list) -> list[str]:
    cleaned: list[str] = []
    for item in values:
        value = str(item).strip()
        if not value:
            continue
        normalized = (
            value.lower()
            .replace("ä", "ae")
            .replace("ö", "oe")
            .replace("ü", "ue")
        )
        contradicts_required_change = (
            "benutzer_array" in normalized
            and (
                "nicht veraendern" in normalized
                or "nicht aendern" in normalized
                or "unveraendert" in normalized
            )
        )
        if contradicts_required_change:
            continue
        cleaned.append(value)
    return cleaned


def canonicalize(handoff: dict) -> dict:
    result = dict(handoff)
    result["acceptance_profile"] = "benutzerfilter-v1"
    result["requested_changes"] = _merge_unique(
        CANONICAL_CHANGES,
        list(result.get("requested_changes", [])),
    )
    model_constraints = _sanitize_model_constraints(
        list(result.get("constraints", []))
    )
    result["constraints"] = _merge_unique(
        CANONICAL_CONSTRAINTS,
        model_constraints,
    )
    result["tests"] = _merge_unique(
        CANONICAL_TESTS,
        list(result.get("tests", [])),
    )
    result["forbidden_paths"] = _merge_unique(
        CANONICAL_FORBIDDEN,
        list(result.get("forbidden_paths", [])),
    )
    return result
